subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lead-in: advertising, appealing or appalling? and slogans
outcomes: Discuss the purpose and effects of adverts
Evaluate slogans and create a slogan for a product

tf.s: The main purpose of advertising is to persuade people to buy a product or service.

tf.why: Appealing means attractive; appalling means very bad.
Appalling is the opposite of appealing.

tf.s: A slogan is a short, memorable phrase used in adverts.
tf.why: Slogans help people remember a product.

tf.s: Adverts can only promote products, never services.
tf.why: Adverts can promote services or organisations, like charities.

tf.s: Adverts can sometimes make us feel bad about ourselves.
tf.why: For example, if we are not as beautiful as the people in the ad.

tf.s: A good slogan should be long and hard to remember.
tf.why: Effective slogans are short and memorable.

tf.s: A service is something someone does for you, not an object you buy.
tf.why: For example, a bank or a taxi is a service.

tf.s: Everyone agrees that adverts do only good.
tf.why: Some people think adverts can do more harm than good.

boxes.q: What do adverts mainly try to do?

boxes.why: A slogan is a short memorable phrase.

boxes.q: What can adverts promote besides products?
boxes.why: Services and organisations can be advertised.

o: make us feel bad about ourselves
boxes.why: Comparing ourselves to models can hurt.

boxes.q: Which is an example of an organisation that advertises?
Which could be a slogan for a school bag?
o: A bag is made of cloth.
boxes.why: It is short, catchy and positive.

mcq.q: What is the main purpose of advertising?
o: to persuade people to buy a product or service
mcq.why: Persuasion is at the heart of advertising.

mcq.q: What is the difference between 'appealing' and 'appalling'?
mcq.why: They sound similar but have opposite meanings.

o: a short memorable phrase used by companies in adverts

mcq.q: Besides products, what can adverts promote?
o: services or organisations such as charities
mcq.why: Advertising is not only for products.

mcq.q: Which is the best slogan for new sportswear?
o: Sportswear is made of cotton and other materials.
We sold sportswear in a shop last year.
Please read the label carefully before washing.
mcq.why: It is short, catchy and persuasive.

mcq.q: A TV advert asks people to give money to help sick children. What is it promoting?
mcq.why: Charities use adverts to get support.

mcq.q: An advert makes you feel your phone is old and you must buy a new one. What is it trying to do?

o: They can make us feel bad if we are not like the people in them
They give us too much free money
mcq.why: Comparing ourselves to models can hurt our feelings.

mcq.q: Why are short slogans usually more effective than long ones?
mcq.why: Memorable slogans stay in our minds.

mcq.q: Why is 'Adverts – Appealing or Appalling?' a good unit title?
o: It asks whether adverts are good or bad
It is a slogan for a car
mcq.why: The title invites us to evaluate adverts.
